issues.title: `ModelicaInternal_temporaryFileName`: Replace `tmpnam` with `mkstemp`
issues.body_summary: Requests atomic temporary-file creation instead of temporary-name generation and raises compatibility of creating a file with an API that currently returns a nonexistent path.
issues.local_version_applicability: Reported tmpnam mechanism exists in local MSL 4.1.0; no security exploit or external-library execution verified.

local_evidence.observation: Function documents a nonexistent temporary path, calls tmpnam(NULL), copies the string, and returns it.

issues.capability_assessment: Scalar numerical observers cannot establish filesystem atomicity, permissions, or race safety.
missing_features: Isolated filesystem concurrency and exclusive-creation harness
Explicit API lifetime and compatibility contract
issues.oracle: Under an agreed creation API, concurrent benign callers get unique exclusively created files with intended permissions and directory semantics; retain a control for old nonexistent-path behavior.
issues.false_positive_control: A linker warning or an unavailable external function is not an executed sanitizer detection; do not silently change API semantics.

issues.title: External functions working with file paths on Windows lack encoding conversions
issues.body_summary: Reports inconsistent Windows pathname encoding at the UTF-8 external-C boundary for producing and consuming paths, with vendor loadResource behavior separately implicated.
issues.local_version_applicability: Direct narrow-character path operations and directory-byte copies exist locally; exact behavior depends on Windows runtime/code page and vendor external-library build. No Windows test performed.

local_evidence.observation: remove(file), opendir(directory), and directory-entry byte copying occur without an explicit conversion in these functions.

issues.capability_assessment: Numerical domain/range checks cannot validate Unicode filesystem roundtrips; Linux-only execution cannot establish the Windows behavior.
missing_features: Filesystem identity and UTF-8 roundtrip oracle
issues.oracle: Create, list, open, rename, and delete identical non-ASCII paths outside the legacy code page, with ASCII controls, while checking UTF-8 bytes and filesystem identity.
issues.false_positive_control: Separate MSL external-C encoding from tool/vendor loadResource conversions; a Linux pass does not refute the Windows issue.

issues.title: Spline interpolation of Blocks.Tables
issues.body_summary: Compares derivatives of CombiTable1Ds interpolation with derivatives from MATLAB-exported spline coefficients; metadata marks the open issue Feature and worksforme.
issues.local_version_applicability: Local MSL 4.1.0 implements table derivative bindings and distinct smoothness modes; attachment and actual interpolation choices are unavailable.

local_evidence.observation: Constant modes have no derivative support, linear modes have no second-derivative support, and smooth modes bind first/second derivatives to external-C functions.
Enumerates different interpolation algorithms with mode-specific continuity promises.

issues.capability_assessment: DomainSan does not detect finite wrong derivatives; DiscontinuitySan does not verify continuity. DifferentialSan provides disagreements, not attribution, and trace samples must be time-aligned before comparison.
missing_features: Recovered exact input data, version, modes, and reproducer
Knot-aware continuity checks and time-aligned differential traces
issues.oracle: Test the derivative of the same interpolation algorithm away from knots, then test only the continuity order promised at knots.
issues.false_positive_control: Different spline algorithms can legitimately produce different derivatives. Preserve intentional linear slope changes and constant jumps. Feature/worksforme alone neither proves a bug nor proves every underlying claim false.
